description: This PHP source file defines a class named TestEnvironmentCommands within the SuiteCRM project. The class extends Robo	asks and provides functions to configure test environments, install ChromeDriver, run ChromeDriver, and simulate a Travis CI environment. It includes methods for setting environment variables on Windows and Unix-based systems, handling file operations, and interfacing with operating system specifics.

classes.name: TestEnvironmentCommands
classes.description: A class for managing test environment setup, ChromeDriver installation, environment variable configuration, and simulation of CI environments within the SuiteCRM project.

methods.name: configureTests
methods.description: Configures environment variables and settings for testing, based on user input and OS detection.

methods.name: chromeDriverInstall
methods.description: Downloads and installs the Chrome WebDriver, with optional reinstallation.

methods.name: chromeDriverRun
methods.description: Runs the Chrome WebDriver server, assuming it is installed.

methods.name: fakeTravis
methods.description: Sets environment variables to simulate a Travis CI environment.

methods.name: installUnixEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Helper method for setting Unix environment variables by editing the ~/.bash_aliases file.

methods.name: installWindowsEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Helper method for setting Windows environment variables via command execution.

methods.name: toEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Formats environment variables as a script string for a specified platform.

methods.name: toWindowsEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Formats environment variables as Windows 'setx' commands.

methods.name: toUnixEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Formats environment variables as Unix 'export' commands.

methods.name: getChromeWebDriverUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the download URL for the latest ChromeDriver version suitable for the host OS.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads a file from a URL to a specified local path.

methods.name: unzip
methods.description: Unzips a given ZIP archive to a specified directory.

methods.name: runChromeWebDriver
methods.description: Starts the Chrome WebDriver executable, platform-dependent.
